=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/review_single_issue_security_pass.sh:417-420 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: single_pass_view_log checks only the first gh on PATH (`command -v gh`). scripts/gh_helpers.sh (`_gh_call_counter_refront`, lines 1098-1118 / 1100-1121, called at 164-168) puts the gh_call_counter shim back at the front of PATH, which is on by default (review_autofix.yml lines 1319-1323, 2543-2547), so every markers_read line prints sig_shim=off.
  WHY: The field exists to show whether a run signed its comments or fell back to the PAT, and it always reads "off". test_gate_logs_the_markers_view accepts sig_shim=(on|off), so it cannot catch this. All reviewers rated it MAJOR, mapped here to high.
- scripts/review_single_issue_security_pass.sh:1187-1530 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: On re-entry, the fresh view is logged at line 1525, then the re-entered gate (SINGLE_PASS_GATE_REENTRY=true, line 1530; gate_view_source="fresh" at 1187) logs the same view again at line 1222. The result is a duplicate `outcome=markers_read source=fresh age_s=0` line.
  WHY: This breaks the agents fragment's contractual "once per view decided on" promise, so consumers counting views overcount. Only diagnostics are affected. All reviewers rated it NIT, mapped here to low.
- scripts/review_single_issue_security_pass.sh:1505-1652 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: Cycle selection reads markers, picks next_cycle, dispatches, and then posts the pending marker, with no atomic reservation in between. The deterministic-skip-merge job (.github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:1223-1227) has no per-PR concurrency group, so overlapping runs can post the same cycle number.
  WHY: This contradicts the no-reuse guarantee in change 3. Severity disagreement: gemini, minimax, gpt and glm said MAJOR; sonnet said NIT at confidence 2 because the race predates the PR and the fresh read narrows the window, and it would only soften the doc claim. The highest rating (MAJOR, mapped to high) is used.
- scripts/review_single_issue_security_pass.sh:1197-1214 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: When the fresh read fails or returns empty (the "20:22 case"), single_pass_gate returns with `outcome=hold reason=markers_unverifiable detail=fresh_read_failed|fresh_read_empty` and never calls single_pass_view_log at line 1222. The required comments, markers, author and source fields are missing on that path.
  WHY: The diagnostics are missing on exactly the failure mode the change targets. Minimax rated it MAJOR; the other reviewers raised the same issue as a task gap, listed below.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "The implementer must confirm the real cause from the code paths that build PR_ISSUE_COMMENTS_FILE, post signed comments and dispatch the audit, before changing behaviour." and "Fix the cause found under 'Cause', if it is in this repository's code. If it is an external limit, say so in the PR and keep changes 1 to 3."
  expected_change_site: scripts/review_collect_pr_metadata.sh, scripts/comment_signature.py and its embedded copy in scripts/gh_helpers.sh (gh_pr_cached_read path, lines 1740-1813), plus PR description / changelog.d/10176-security-pass-marker-reread.md / agents.d/10176-security-pass-marker-reread.md
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: changelog.d/10176-security-pass-marker-reread.md says "Why the failing runs posted unsigned comments is not confirmed". The agents fragment says the job-token fallback "is not confirmed from code" yet asserts the stale-snapshot cause without verifying it. No hunk fixes a confirmed cause, and the PR does not state an external limit. The only edits that hunt for the cause are the AI_COMMENT_SIG fallback-reason logging in scripts/comment_signature.py:561-579 and its gh_helpers.sh copy. The PR does not examine _gh_pr_cache_entry_fresh (gh_helpers.sh lines 1728-1731), which applies no age limit to issue_comments entries keyed by head SHA.
- requirement: "The gate logs ... whether the comments file came from a fresh read, a cache or a fallback." (Issue #10176, Changes item 1)
  expected_change_site: scripts/review_collect_pr_metadata.sh lines 233-247 (.source sidecar), gh_pr_cached_read in scripts/gh_helpers.sh
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  EVIDENCE: issue_comments_source is set to "cache" whenever gh_pr_cached_read is a function (lines 234-235). That one label covers a cache hit with no age limit (lines 1779-1782), a cache miss with a live fetch (1784-1793), and the _gh_pr_cache_live fallbacks (1757-1761, 1760, 1770, 1775, 1787). No source value is "fallback", and the agents fragment's contract `cache|direct|synthesized|fresh|unknown` has no fallback token. age_s is measured from the sidecar write (line 247), not from when the data was fetched, so a stale cache hit looks fresh.
- requirement: "The gate logs, on one line with the existing SINGLE_ISSUE_SECURITY_PASS mode=gate prefix: the number of comments read, the number of markers kept, the author login it filtered by, and whether the comments file came from a fresh read, a cache or a fallback."
  expected_change_site: single_pass_gate / single_pass_view_log in scripts/review_single_issue_security_pass.sh (markers_unverifiable hold paths)
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: The fresh-read failure/empty hold (lines 1516-1523 / 1518) and the unusable-snapshot hold (lines 1197-1214 / 1209-1214 / 1211) both return before single_pass_view_log at line 1222. They log only `outcome=hold reason=markers_unverifiable${snapshot_detail}` without the comments, markers, author and source fields. This is the incident-shaped path (PR #10175 20:22), and acceptance criterion 4 requires the four fields.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/review_single_issue_security_pass.sh:single_pass_view_log, lines 417-420 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: sig_shim looks only at the first gh on PATH. gh_helpers.sh lines 164-167 call _gh_call_counter_refront (lines 1098-1118), which puts the counter dir back in front. The counter is on by default (review_autofix.yml lines 1319-1323, 2543-2547).
  WHY: In production, command -v gh resolves to <RUNNER_TEMP>/gh_call_counter.XXXXXX/gh, so sig_shim is always off, and the test accepts on|off. Fix: walk PATH entries the way gh_helpers.sh lines 57-70 do. Do not use AI_COMMENT_SIG_SHIM_DIR (line 158 says only the directory is saved for later steps).
- scripts/review_single_issue_security_pass.sh:line 1525, re-entry at line 1530, re-log at line 1222 (gate_view_source="fresh" around line 1187) | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: Each re-entry logs the same fresh view twice as "outcome=markers_read ... source=fresh age_s=0".
  WHY: This breaks "once per view decided on": three lines for two views. Diagnostics only. Fix: drop the call at 1525 when re-entry follows, or skip the 1222 call when SINGLE_PASS_GATE_REENTRY=true.
- scripts/review_single_issue_security_pass.sh:1505-1544; .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml line 1223 | severity=NIT | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: The cycle number is read and then posted with no atomic reservation, so overlapping runs can post the same cycle.
  WHY: The race predates this PR, and the fresh read narrows the window. The changelog and stage_switches "never" reused claim is contradicted; fix the doc wording rather than add locking.
- TASK_GAP: Requirement: "The implementer must confirm the real cause ... before changing behaviour." / Changes item 4. Expected change site: scripts/review_collect_pr_metadata.sh, gh_pr_cached_read in scripts/gh_helpers.sh (lines 1740-1813), scripts/comment_signature.py and its copy, the PR description or changelog.d/10176-security-pass-marker-reread.md. Evidence of absence: the changelog says the cause is "not confirmed", and the agents fragment says the fallback "is not confirmed from code". No fix and no external-limit statement. _gh_pr_cache_entry_fresh (gh_helpers.sh lines 1728-1731) has no age limit and was not examined. | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
- TASK_GAP: Requirement: "The gate logs ... whether the comments file came from a fresh read, a cache or a fallback." Expected change site: scripts/review_collect_pr_metadata.sh lines 233-247, gh_pr_cached_read. Evidence of absence: "cache" is set whenever the function exists (lines 234-235), covering a hit (line 1780), a miss (line 1784) and fallbacks (lines 1760, 1770, 1775, 1787). There is no "fallback" value, and age_s comes from the sidecar write (line 247). | severity=MAJOR | confidence=3
- TASK_GAP: Requirement: the one-line log with comments, markers, author and source. Expected change site: single_pass_gate, early markers_unverifiable hold. Evidence of absence: the hold returns before single_pass_view_log at line 1222. | severity=NIT | confidence=4
- HARDENING (3 related items): sig_shim PATH scan (lines 417-420, ~6 lines); sidecar cache_hit/cache_miss/fallback tokens (review_collect_pr_metadata.sh lines 234-247, ~8 lines); wrap single_pass_fresh_comments (lines 329-345) in gh_retry (~2 lines). HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
